history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V15 workload, scored mode, job count, checksum, timing boundary, engine-availability ruling, acceptance decision, and attribution metric. It changes no scored row. It integrates the completed issue-503 efficiency/thermal publication guard and issue-504 independent-suite/additional-engine boundary as hash-pinned external panels, then empties the pending-panel inventory. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Freezes completed efficiency/thermal and independent-suite corroboration beside the unchanged representative rows. These panels strengthen publication evidence without folding external-suite scores into repository-owned aggregates, inventing unavailable counters, rewriting historical reports, or adding an ordinary dependency.

scored_integration.publication_boundary: Only an explicitly selected quiet-reference host on AC power may support an efficiency claim. Required counters must be measured and stable at at most 5% RSD, every thermal observation must remain nominal, generated-code/cache claims additionally require their exact category metric, and every raw sample remains visible. Diagnostic hosts never gate or support a public ratio.

disabled_path_fixture.evidence_ruling: The checked artifact is a seven-pair battery-host diagnostic of the opt-in boundary, not a quiet-reference efficiency claim. Current collection additionally fails closed on counter availability, calibration noise, power, and thermal drift.

recognizer.required_equivalence: Exact pinned sources and deterministic source-hash-mutated variants must retain identical required output contracts and identical nonzero execution-tier and bytecode-admission sets. Scored upstream sources remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

independent_suite.publication_boundary: Independent-suite artifacts remain out of tree and outside ordinary dependencies. Every applicable row, failure, skip, raw sample, dispersion value, output check, timed boundary, engine/dependency identity, and exclusion remains visible. The retired selected Octane subset is corroboration only and is never folded into the repository-owned representative aggregate or described as a browser/full-suite score.
